:::: {.about-intro}
I am a junior lecturer in the [Internet Engineering Technology](https://tri.sv.ugm.ac.id/) program at Universitas Gadjah Mada, Yogyakarta. My research focuses on **intelligent communication systems**, with work on eye tracking, human-centred sensing, and applied artificial intelligence.
